description: This file provides macOS-specific adapter functions for integrating hiredis asynchronous Redis client with CoreFoundation run loop, including socket management and callback handling.

methods.name: freeRedisRunLoop
methods.description: Frees resources associated with RedisRunLoop, invalidating and releasing socket and run loop source.

methods.name: redisMacOSAddRead
methods.description: Enables read callbacks on the socket.

methods.name: redisMacOSDelRead
methods.description: Disables read callbacks on the socket.

methods.name: redisMacOSAddWrite
methods.description: Enables write callbacks on the socket.

methods.name: redisMacOSDelWrite
methods.description: Disables write callbacks on the socket.

methods.name: redisMacOSAsyncCallback
methods.description: Handles socket read/write events and calls appropriate redisAsyncHandle functions.

methods.name: redisMacOSAttach
methods.description: Attaches redisAsyncContext to a CFRunLoop with socket setup and callback registration.
